contests.title: Phenix City School District in Russell County — 4-mill school tax renewal

provenance.quote:
4 MILL PHENIX CITY SCHOOL TAX
PHENIX CITY SCHOOL DISTRICT
SPECIAL ELECTION FOR RENEWAL
AND
CONTINUATION OF THE LEVY OF
A 4 MILL SCHOOL TAX
(Section 269.02, Constitution of Alabama
of 2022)
Shall the governing body of Russell County,
Alabama, be authorized to levy annually, for
a period of thirty (30) consecutive years
commencing with the tax year that will
begin on October 1, 2026 (for which tax
year the tax will become due and payable
on October 1, 2027), a special district tax of
forty cents on each one hundred dollars
(equal to 4 mills on each dollar) of the
assessed value of the taxable property
located within the Phenix City School
District in said county for public school
purposes, which special district tax shall be
in renewal and continuation of the special
district tax at the same rate and for the
same purpose that is now being levied in
the said district?
FOR PROPOSED TAXATION
AGAINST PROPOSED TAXATION

contests.title: Odenville School Attendance and Tax District — Additional 15-mill school tax

provenance.quote:
ODENVILLE SCHOOL ATTENDANCE
AND TAX DISTRICT
ELECTION FOR
THE LEVY OF A FIFTEEN (15)
MILL SCHOOL DISTRICT TAX
(Section 59-10.21 of the Constitution of
Alabama of 2022)
Shall the governing body of St. Clair
County, Alabama, be authorized to levy a
special district tax of $1.50 on each one
hundred dollars (equal to fifteen (15) mills
on each dollar) of the assessed value of
the taxable property located within the
Odenville School Attendance and Tax
District in said county, the area
comprising the said district being fully
described in proceedings of the St. Clair
County Commission calling this election,
for public school purposes for a period of
thirty (30) consecutive years commencing
with the tax year that will begin on
October 1, 2026 (for which tax year the
tax will become due and payable on
October 1, 2027), which levy shall be in
addition to all taxes now or hereafter
authorized to be levied in said school
district?
FOR PROPOSED TAXATION
AGAINST PROPOSED TAXATION

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews the existing 4-mill property tax for public schools in the part of Phenix City School District located in Russell County for 30 years. It would start with the tax year beginning October 1, 2026, with taxes first payable October 1, 2027. The rate remains 40 cents per $100 of assessed property value, for the same public-school purposes.
measureRecords.yesMeans: A FOR vote approves this 30-year renewal at the existing rate.
measureRecords.noMeans: An AGAINST vote rejects this proposed renewal.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Adds a property tax for public schools in Odenville School Attendance and Tax District for 30 years. The new tax would be $1.50 per $100 of assessed property value, or 15 mills, in addition to other authorized taxes. It would start with the tax year beginning October 1, 2026, with taxes first payable October 1, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: A FOR vote authorizes this additional school-district property tax.
measureRecords.noMeans: An AGAINST vote rejects the additional tax.
